question: Should OpenAI device-code login adopt a fixed 30-second deadline for user-code and token-exchange operations while retrying only timed-out authorization polls within the existing 15-minute window?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but this timeout establishes user-visible auth behavior for slow networks and proxies that tests and CI cannot choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the 30-second contract
options.body: Accept the proposed sibling-aligned deadline and poll-only retry behavior, then rebase and merge after focused checks remain green.

options.title: Tune the timeout policy
options.body: Choose a different duration or retry policy and update the implementation, messages, and regression proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Keep the existing unbounded behavior temporarily if auth owners do not yet want a fixed operational deadline.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed sibling-aligned deadline and poll-only retry behavior, then rebase and merge after focused checks remain green.
